summary: Ecopetrol S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing an exhibit announcing that its Board of Directors, at a September 30, 2026 meeting, approved the appointment of three new senior management members effective no later than October 6, 2026. Monica Jimenez Gonzalez was named Corporate Vice President of Legal Affairs and General Secretary, Mauricio Gutierrez Corporate Vice President of Strategy and New Business, and a third appointee was detailed in the excerpt. The filing is a Colombian foreign private issuer's US-equivalent Form 8-K current report on management changes. No financial terms, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics were disclosed; the event is an orderly leadership transition rather than a forced or abrupt departure. Watch for the remaining appointee's identity and any subsequent strategic or capital-allocation shifts under new leadership.
